notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The second major update for Laserboy VR is here! 

If you are still on the fence, now is a perfect time to hop into the action! Let's dive in to all the new content releasing today:

[h1]UFO 2.0 [/h1]
[list]
[*] UFOs have been completely reworked. UFO Health is now randomized! 
[*] As rounds progress, UFOs will become more aggressive, increasing both their movement speed and rate of fire.
[*] New UFO Behavior: UFOs will now periodically vanish for a second before reappearing in a new 
location. This teleportation-like behavior repeats every few seconds, keeping players on their toes. [/list]


[img]https://media.fab.com/image_previews/gallery_images/57aedd7f-7f5c-40aa-9bca-a2091ad119e7/bbdfb697-7cc6-40f1-b842-6900fbc8dae8.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Enemy: Drone[/h1]

A new enemy has arrived – the Drone! Keep an eye on the skies, as this foe will fly and attack from above spawning in with a red-shield for 4 seconds. 

[h1]New Power-Up: Quad-Shot[/h1]
A brand new power-up has been added, giving you the ability to fire four shots at once! This four-shot power-up will help you take down enemies more efficiently. Look for the yellow power-up!


[h1]Endless Mode 2.0[/h1]
Endless Mode has been reworked to ensure each round is unique! A random mix of UFOs, Drones, and power-ups will spawn, keeping the action fresh and exciting. The difficulty will get also increasingly harder every 5 rounds -- Let us know your thoughts! 


[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Number of UFOs and Drones will always be random!
[*] Power-Up will now always spawn at random!
[*] Fixed an issue with Laserbeam colors not always saving!
[*] Improved enemy hitbox!
[*] improved explosion VFX!
[*] Updated store images! (Upgrades now cost 3000 instead of 10000 coins.)
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates! Thank you for playing our game.

Tuckspace Games

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 Released
notes.notes:
Hello!

Here is the first official update for Laserboy VR! Introducing...

[previewyoutube=1_zQJY3QlnA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Upgrades[/h1]
You can now use coins to upgrade your maximum HP or slow-time ability via the shop! 
Each upgrade will add +5 health or 10seconds. Upgrade wisely! 
(Default HP: 10  / Default slow-time ability: 5 seconds)

[h1]New Power-Up: Shields[/h1]
Look for the new blue power-up! A shield will spawn and block incoming lasers for 10 seconds. Players can also move and shoot while the shield is active.

[h1]UFO Difficulty[/h1]
We have tweaked current UFO health to be random and slightly modified their spawn + attack patterns. 
We will be monitoring for additional changes!


[h1]Quality of Life Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated Power-up model to sphere
[*] Added new blue bar to show the usage of the slow-time ability 
[*] Reduced hud size by 10%
[/list]

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfdYen_hUQnpR9ibYGDduHPKv26PnzAL_ahE-TEsU-Z1f67TQ/viewform]We are always looking for more bug reports and feedback![/url]


Stay tuned for more future updates! Thank you for playing our game.

Tuckspace Games

notes.title: What's next for Laserboy VR?
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been almost two weeks since Laserboy VR was released! We are thrilled by the number of players and love the game has received so far. Today we would like to share what we have in plans for Laserboy VR's future. This may happen in several updates. 

[h1]Upgrades[/h1]
We are adding a brand new feature to spend coins towards upgrading your maximum HP or your maximum slow-time ability! 

[h1]Powerups[/h1]
We are looking to add new powerups such as Shields and other fun new mechanics!

[h1]Enemies[/h1]
A big suggestion was adding more enemies. We are currently brainstorming new enemies that will bring waves of new challenges to the game!

[h1]Difficulty[/h1]
Another suggestion was increasing enemy attack difficulty. We have tweaked current UFO health to be random and modified their spawn + attack patterns for our next update. We will be monitoring for additional changes!

[h1]Maps[/h1]
A big suggestion was larger maps. In a future update, we will be adding our largest map yet for players to explore. Our 4 current maps are just the beginning - stay tuned! 

[h1]Customization[/h1]
We are looking into new customizations such as additional laserbeam colors, weapon customization, new weapons and more!


[h1]Feedback[/h1]
[url=www.tuckspacegames.com/support]We are always looking for more feedback ! [/url]


Thank you all for supporting our game!
Tuckspace Games

notes.title: Laserboy VR launches today!
notes.notes:
🚀 Welcome to Laserboy VR!  🚀

[previewyoutube=ofbu7r6s3P4;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey everyone!

The time has finally come—LaserboyVR is officially LIVE! 🎉🔥 Whether you’ve been following our journey or just discovered us, we’re beyond excited to welcome you into the world of high-speed, laser-fueled action.


🕶️ What is LaserboyVR?
Immerse yourself in the world of Laserboy, Armed with powerful laser weapons and the unique ability to slow time, players must battle waves of enemies across a variety of different environments. Packed with thrilling power-ups and dynamic gameplay mechanics, Laserboy VR delivers an exhilarating and replayable experience for all ages.

✔️ Action-packed laser battles and evasive combat
✔️ Slow down time to gain the upper hand
✔️ Discover 4 distinct and exciting maps
✔️ Customize your Laserbeam Color
✔️ Survive in 'Endless Mode'

✔️ And plenty more surprises along the way!

See you in VR! 🚀✨
